transform.description: Position, rotation (Euler degrees) and scale relative to the parent entity.

position.description: Position in meters relative to parent; +Y is up

rotation.description: Euler angles in degrees [pitch(X), yaw(Y), roll(Z)]

mesh.description: Renders a mesh with a simple physically based material.
Primitive (cube, sphere, plane, cylinder, cone, quad, capsule, torus) or "asset:<path>" (.obj/.glb/.gltf)

color.description: Base color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

emissive.description: Emitted light color; alpha is strength — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

texture.description: Optional albedo texture path (png/jpg), relative to project

billboard.description: Always face the camera (useful for 2D sprites)

material.description: Material asset path (*.mat.json); when set it overrides color/metallic/roughness/emissive/texture

unlit.description: Flat color/texture without lighting (2D, UI, stylized)

shading.description: pbr = physically based, toon = cel bands + crisp highlights, unlit = flat, water = animated waves (use on a large plane; color = deep water tint)

normalMap.description: Normal map (png), project-relative; adds surface detail

emissiveMap.description: Emission mask/color map, multiplied with emissive

triplanar.description: Project textures in world space: no stretching on scaled shapes

clearcoat.description: Glossy lacquer layer on top (car paint, varnish)

subsurface.description: Light bleeding through (skin, leaves, wax, snow)

outline.description: Cartoon outline width in pixels (0 = none)

outlineColor.description: Outline color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

alphaCutoff.description: Alpha-tested cutout: texture alpha below this is cut (foliage, fences, sails); 0 = off

layers.description: Render layers bitmask (bit 0 = layer 1 .. bit 19 = layer 20; default 1). A camera draws the mesh when its cullMask shares a bit; a light lights it when the light's cullMask does. Name layers in game.json and set them by name with render_layers

light.description: A light source. Directional lights use the entity rotation; point/spot use position.

color.description: Light color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

cullMask.description: Render layers this light illuminates (bitmask, bit 0 = layer 1; default all 20). E.g. a rim light that only lights the hero: put the hero on layer 2 and set cullMask 2

indirect.description: Contribution to world-space GI (reserved for GI probes / lightmaps)

volumetric.description: Strength in volumetric light / god rays (environment godRays)

temperature.description: Color temperature in Kelvin, multiplied with color (1900 candle, 2700 tungsten, 4000 fluorescent, 5500 noon, 6500 white, 9000 overcast sky); 0 = off

innerAngle.description: Spot: half-angle of the full-intensity inner cone in degrees (0 = automatic); smaller = softer edge

negative.description: Subtract light instead of adding it (stylized darkening)

distanceFade.description: Fade the light out with distance from the camera (cheap crowds of small lights)

fadeBegin.description: Distance fade: meters from the camera where fading starts

fadeLength.description: Distance fade: meters over which the light fades out

attenuation.description: Falloff: smooth = soft artist-friendly curve that reaches 0 at range; inverse_square = physical 1/d^2 (brighter near the source, uses size), still windowed to range

size.description: Emitter radius in meters (inverse_square falloff peak)

castShadows.description: Point/spot: occluders block the light (no light through walls). Rendered in the local shadow atlas, cached while nothing in range moves; see shadow_atlas_info

shadowBias.description: Shadow depth bias in meters: raise if lit surfaces show dark speckles (acne), lower if shadows detach from their casters (peter-panning)

shadowNormalBias.description: Shadow offset along the surface normal in shadow-map texels (acne on surfaces at grazing angles)

shadowResolution.description: Shadow map slot hint in px (256 small, 1024 hero light, 2048 max); 0 = automatic from the light's size on screen

shadowMaxDistance.description: Camera distance (m) beyond which this light's shadow fades out (saves atlas space); 0 = no limit

shadowMode.description: Point light shadow projection: cube = 6 exact views; dual_paraboloid = 2 views, cheaper to update but approximate for large flat polygons

camera.description: A camera. The first primary camera is used when the game runs.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees

orthoSize.description: Half the visible height in orthographic mode

aperture.description: Depth of field f-stop: 1.4 very shallow .. 16 deep (0 = off)

focusDistance.description: Focus distance in meters (0 = autofocus on the frame center)

motionBlur.description: Motion blur shutter (0.5 = film-like 180 degrees, 0 = off)

tiltShift.description: Tilt-shift miniature look: blur above and below a sharp band across the middle of the frame (0 = off, 1 = strong)

cullMask.description: Render layers this camera draws (bitmask, bit 0 = layer 1; default all 20). E.g. hide first-person arms from a security camera, or editor-only helpers from the game camera

particles.description: Particle emitter: fire, smoke, embers, sparks, rain, snow, mist, magic. Simulated by the engine and drawn as soft HDR particles. Easiest start: fx_create with a preset, then tweak fields.

emitting.description: Emit new particles (existing ones finish their life)

look.description: glow = soft light points; flame = animated fire tongues; smoke = lit billowing volume; spark = glowing streaks; rain = lit falling streaks; snow = soft flakes; mist = drifting fog; sprite = textured / flipbook sheet (`texture`, gpu only)

burst.description: Particles emitted at once when it starts (explosions); Wander burst(n) emits more

maxParticles.description: Upper bound of live particles (cpu: up to 50000; gpu: up to 4000000)

shape.description: Where particles are born (scaled by shapeSize)

direction.description: Emission direction in the entity's space

gravity.description: Downward acceleration (m/s^2); negative = rises like hot gas

wind.description: How strongly the environment wind carries particles

colorStart.description: Color at birth (alpha = opacity) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

colorEnd.description: Color at death (alpha = opacity) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

stretch.description: Streak length along velocity (seconds of motion)

worldSpace.description: Particles stay behind when the emitter moves (trails)

collide.description: Collide with the floor plane at floorHeight

floorHeight.description: World height of the collision floor

light.description: Light cast on the scene (flickers with the particles)

lightColor.description: Color of the cast light — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

prewarm.description: Start fully developed instead of from nothing

seed.description: Random seed (variations of the same effect)

simulation.description: cpu = deterministic engine simulation (gameplay, countable); gpu = compute shaders, millions of particles, depth collisions, sub-emitters, ribbons, mesh particles (visuals only)

facing.description: gpu: camera = billboards; velocity = stretched along motion (`stretch`); horizontal = flat on the ground plane (ripples, decals); ribbon = trails (`trailLength`); mesh = instanced lit meshes (`mesh`)

mesh.description: gpu facing mesh: primitive (cube, sphere...), "asset:<path>", or built-in fx:leaf, fx:shard, fx:pebble

texture.description: gpu look sprite: sprite or flipbook sheet (png/jpg), project-relative

flipbookFps.description: Flipbook frames per second (0 = once over each life; frames cross-fade)

colorGradient.description: gpu: color over life, e.g. "#fff6d0@0 #ffa030@0.2 #a01800@0.7 #20000000@1" (overrides colorStart/End)

sizeCurve.description: gpu: size multiplier over life, e.g. "0@0 1@0.1 0.3@1"

opacityCurve.description: gpu: opacity multiplier over life, e.g. "0@0 1@0.2 0@1"

shapeMesh.description: gpu shape mesh: emit from this mesh's surface ("" = this entity's mesh)

field.description: gpu force field: vortex = swirl around fieldAxis (tornado, magic); attractor = pull toward fieldCenter; texture = vector field from fieldTexture (.fga)

fieldTexture.description: Vector field file (.fga from Houdini or EmberGen)

fieldSize.description: Box covered by the vector field (m, centered on fieldCenter)

depthCollision.description: gpu: collide with everything visible on screen (scene depth + normals): sparks bouncing off props, rain splashing on roofs

stick.description: gpu: particles stick where they collide (paint, snow, blood)

colliders.description: gpu: entities particles bounce off: sphere meshes collide as spheres, planes/quads as planes, other meshes as bounding spheres — entity links: ["Hand", "#12", {"id": 7}] (a comma-separated string also works)

subEmitter.description: gpu: another gpu particles entity spawned where these particles die/hit (sparks -> embers, rockets -> fireworks) — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

subEmitInherit.description: Fraction of the parent's velocity inherited

sort.description: gpu blended looks: sort back to front on the GPU (off = faster)

lightShadows.description: The cast light (light > 0) is blocked by occluders (torches in caves; costs a cube shadow map)

hueVariation.description: gpu: random hue rotation per particle; sub-emitted particles share their event's hue (fireworks)

water.description: Water surface with a spectral (FFT) ocean simulation: wind waves, choppy crests, foam, refraction, depth color and reflections. Entity y = water level. Query wave heights with water_query / Wander water_height().

windSpeed.description: Wind speed (m/s): 2 calm lake, 8 breezy sea, 18 storm

size.description: Square extent in meters (0 = endless ocean)

depth.description: Water depth for wave physics (shallow water slows waves)

deepColor.description: Light scattered inside deep water — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

shallowColor.description: Tint of what you see through shallow water — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

clarity.description: How far you can see into the water (m)

seed.description: Random seed of the wave field

terrain.description: Large heightfield terrain (islands, beaches, mountains, canyons, dunes) with erosion, up to 8 blended material layers and wet shorelines. Rendered with continuous LOD. Use terrain_create, terrain_sculpt, terrain_paint and terrain_layers; heights are relative to the entity.

data.description: Project-relative .terrain file with heights and layer weights

generator.description: Generation parameters (shape, seed, minHeight, maxHeight, featureSize, ridges, warp, erosion, thermal, terraces, beachWidth, seaLevel; shape heightmap: heightmap image, detailNoise)

layers.description: Material layers, base first. Each: {name, texture, normalMap, ormMap, color, roughness, tiling (m), heightMin, heightMax, slopeMin, slopeMax, noise, sharpness}. Rules auto-paint the weights.

edits.description: Recorded hand edits in terrain-local meters, replayed in order over the generator when the terrain cache is rebuilt: {op: sculpt|paint|autopaint, strokes, layer}. Written by terrain_sculpt, terrain_paint and terrain_layers; cleared by terrain_generate.

waterLevel.description: World height of the water line (wet sand/soil just above it)

wetBand.description: Meters above the water line that stay damp

macroVariation.description: Large-scale tone and hue variation over the whole landscape (0 = off, 0.5 natural)

overlay.description: Image draped over the whole terrain (row 0 = -Z edge): political/region maps, borders, paper maps. Alpha masks it; swap it at run time for map modes

overlayBlend.description: mix paints over the ground (matte, keeps the relief shading), multiply tints it, glow adds the color unlit (highlights, borders that read at night)

foliage.description: GPU-instanced scattering of grass, flowers, ferns, pebbles, shells, rocks and trees over a terrain (this entity or its parent) or over scene meshes inside `area`. Wind-animated, deterministic. Use foliage_add with presets.

impostors.description: Draw far instances as baked octahedral impostors (default true; used when the mesh has 300+ triangles)

impostorDistance.description: Camera distance in meters where instances become impostors: 0 = automatic from on-screen size, -1 = never

impostorResolution.description: Impostor atlas edge in pixels: 0 = automatic, 512-2048 by model size

layers.description: Layers: [{preset, mesh | prefab, color, density (/m²), scaleMin, scaleMax, slopeMin, slopeMax, heightMin, heightMax, terrainLayer, wind, cullDistance, castShadows, clumping, alignToNormal, impostors, impostorDistance, impostorResolution, impostorFrames}]. Distant instances of heavy meshes draw as octahedral impostors (see impostor_bake).

area.description: Scene mode: extent in meters around the entity

fluid.description: Volumetric fluid simulation for fire, smoke, steam and explosions (GPU 3D solver, ray-marched): fuel burns into heat and soot, hot gas rises and swirls. The box sits on the entity (bottom center). Start with fx_create (volume_fire, volume_smoke, steam_vent, explosion_volume...).

emitting.description: Feed the source (off: the fire dies down)

size.description: Simulation box in meters (fire lives inside it)

resolution.description: Cells along the longest side (detail vs. cost)

sourceOffset.description: Source position from the box's bottom center (m)

fuel.description: Fuel fed per second (0 = smoke/steam only)

burnRate.description: How fast fuel burns (lower = taller flames)

smokeColor.description: Smoke albedo (dark soot .. white steam) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

light.description: Light the fire casts on the scene

lightColor.description: Color of the cast light — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

burst.description: Seconds of heavy fuel at start (explosions, fireballs)

lightShadows.description: The fire's light is blocked by occluders (campfires in caves and rooms; costs a cube shadow map)

sprite.description: A textured quad on the entity's XY plane (2D characters, props, backgrounds, pixel art, 2.5D billboards). Painter's order: sortingLayer, then order, then depth.

frame.description: Atlas frame name or frame index ("3"); empty = first frame / whole image

region.description: Explicit pixel rect [x, y, w, h] in the image (overrides frame)

pivot.description: Origin within the frame: [0.5, 0.5] center, [0.5, 0] feet, [0, 0] bottom-left

size.description: World size [w, h]; 0 = pixels / pixelsPerUnit (one 0 keeps the aspect)

pixelsPerUnit.description: Texture pixels per world unit (pixel art: 16 or 32)

color.description: Tint and opacity — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

order.description: Order within the layer (higher = in front)

filter.description: Texture sampling: linear (painted art) or nearest (pixel art)

emissive.description: Glow color, alpha = strength (blooms) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

billboard.description: Face the camera: none, y (upright, turns around Y) or full

lit.description: Lit by 2D lights when the scene has any (else full bright)

alphaCutoff.description: Hard cutout below this alpha (0 = soft edges)

sprite_anim.description: Flipbook animation for the entity's sprite. clips: {"run": {"frames": "4-11", "fps": 12, "loop": true, "events": {"3": "footstep"}}}. frames: index ranges ("0-3,6"), lists ([0, 1, 2] or ["run_0", ...]) or an atlas name pattern ("run_*"); a clip may switch sheets with "texture", "columns", "rows". Frame events reach the entity's behaviors as `on anim "footstep"`; non-looping clips send `on anim "finished"`.

clips.description: Clip name -> {frames, fps, loop, events, texture?, columns?, rows?}

tilemap.description: A grid of tiles in layers. Cell (0, 0) is the top-left at the entity position; cells go right (+x) and down (-y) in world space. Tile ids: 0 = empty, n = the n-th tile of the tileset (1-based, left->right, top->bottom). Edit with tilemap_paint / tilemap_from_ascii; layer data is compact text ("rle:..." or "b64z:...").

layers.description: [{name, data, solid (true | "tiles"), visible, z, tint, sortingLayer, order}] bottom to top

solidTiles.description: Tile ids that collide in layers with solid: "tiles" ([3, "10-20"])

sortingLayer.description: Draw layer of all tile layers (unless a layer overrides it)

order.description: Order within the sorting layer (each tile layer adds its index)

light2d.description: A 2D light: point, spot (cone along the entity's local +Y) or global (ambient for the whole 2D scene). With any 2D light in the scene, lit sprites are dark except where light falls; normal maps add relief.

color.description: Light color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

height.description: Height above the sprite plane (normal-map relief)

shadows.description: Cast shadows from castShadows sprites and solid tiles

halo.description: Visible glow in the air around the light

parallax.description: Parallax scrolling for this entity and its children (2D, orthographic cameras): they move at `factor` of the camera's motion. 0 = fixed to the camera (sky), 0.1-0.6 = far layers, 1 = normal, > 1 = near foreground.

factor.description: Motion relative to the camera per axis

origin.description: Camera position at which the layer is at its authored position

repeatX.description: Repeat sprites horizontally to fill the view (endless backgrounds)

spacing.description: Repeat period in world units (0 = sprite size)

camera2d.description: 2D camera behavior (put it on the camera entity): orthographic, pixel-perfect integer scaling, texel snapping, smooth target following with a dead zone, and level bounds.

pixelsPerUnit.description: Art texels per world unit (match the sprites)

referenceHeight.description: Game pixels tall (e.g. 180 or 270): integer upscaling for crisp pixel art; 0 = camera.orthoSize

pixelSnap.description: Snap the view to the texel grid (no shimmering)

follow.description: Entity to follow; empty = none — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

deadZone.description: Half-size of the box the target moves in without moving the camera

bounds.description: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] the view stays inside (all 0 = unbounded)

text.description:
Text in the world (signs, labels, damage numbers, speech bubbles). SDF-rendered: crisp at any zoom. Supports rich text:
.

font.description: Inter (default), EB Garamond (serif), JetBrains Mono (mono), or a .ttf path

color.description: Text color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

maxWidth.description: Wrap width in world units (0 = no wrap)

outlineColor.description: Outline color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

shadowColor.description: Drop shadow color (alpha 0 = none) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

shadowOffset.description: Drop shadow offset in world units

ui_canvas.description: Root of a user interface. Children with a `ui` component are laid out in canvas pixels (origin top-left, y down). screen = overlay scaled from referenceResolution; world = a panel in the scene. Build whole UIs with ui_create; restyle with ui_style.

scaleMode.description: scale_with_screen (resolution independent) or constant (1 px = 1 px)

styleSheet.description: Style sheet (*.uistyle.json) layered over the theme

worldScale.description: World mode: world units per canvas pixel

ui.description: A UI element under a ui_canvas. Rect: anchor preset + position (offset, y down) + size, or stretch with margin. A layout (row/column/grid) arranges children with gap/padding/align/justify; fit sizes to content. Look comes from the theme/style sheet by widget kind and `style` classes, plus styleOverrides. Activating a button/toggle/slider sends Wander `on ui "<name>"` (and `on click` to the element).

anchor.description: Where it attaches in its parent: corners/edges/center, fill, or *_stretch bands; custom uses anchorMin/anchorMax/pivot

anchorMin.description: custom anchor: parent fraction [x, y] (0,0 = top-left)

anchorMax.description: custom anchor: parent fraction [x, y]; differs from anchorMin = stretch

pivot.description: custom anchor: the element's own reference point [x, y] (0,0 = top-left)

position.description: Offset from the anchor in pixels [x, y] (y down)

size.description: Size in pixels [w, h] (ignored on stretched axes)

margin.description: Insets on stretched axes [top, right, bottom, left]

padding.description: Inner padding [top, right, bottom, left] (CSS shorthand ok: 12 or [8, 16])

flex.description: Share of leftover space in a row/column (0 = fixed size)

ignoreLayout.description: Placed by its own anchor even inside a layout

event.description: Extra event sent when activated (in addition to ui:<name>)

visible.description: Shown (hidden elements and their children take no space)

scroll.description: Scroll views: content offset in pixels

dialogue.description: Runs a .dialogue script (Yarn-style: nodes, `Speaker: line #tags`, `-> choices`, <<set>>, <<if>>, <<jump>>, custom <<commands>> sent to Wander as `on dialogue "name"`) with a built-in, restylable dialogue box. Start it with Wander start_dialogue("Node"); lint with dialogue_check; simulate with dialogue_preview.

source.description: Inline script (used when script is empty)

ui.description: default = built-in dialogue box; none = drive your own UI

running.description: State: a conversation is in progress

speaker.description: State: speaker of the current line

tags.description: State: tags of the current line ({"mood": "angry"})

audio.description: Plays a sound clip from this entity: music, ambience, sound effects. Spatial by default (louder when near, panned left/right). Plays only while the game runs. Generate clips with the audio_generate tool, then set `clip`. One-shots are easier from Wander: play_sound("audio/hit.wav").

clip.description: Audio file in the project (wav, mp3 or flac), e.g. audio/wind_loop.wav

pitch.description: Playback speed multiplier; also shifts pitch

loop.description: Repeat the clip forever (ambience, music, engines)

playOnStart.description: Start automatically when the game starts

spatial.description: 3D sound: distance attenuation and panning; false = plain stereo (music, UI)

maxDistance.description: Distance where attenuation stops (inverse/exponential) or reaches silence (linear)

rolloff.description: Distance falloff curve (inverse is physically natural; linear fades to silence at maxDistance)

bus.description: Mixer bus whose volume/mute applies (see the audio_mix tool)

doppler.description: Doppler effect strength for moving emitters (0 = off, 1 = realistic)

listener.description: The ears of the game. Optional: by default sound is heard from the active scene camera. Put this on another entity (the player character) to hear from there.

enabled.description: Use this entity as the listener

volume.description: Overall gain heard by this listener

body.description: Simulated rigid body (Jolt). dynamic = moved by forces and collisions, kinematic = moved by its transform (platforms, doors) and pushes dynamic bodies, static = never moves. Needs no collider: the shape is fitted to the mesh. Child entities with a collider (and no body of their own) become parts of this body.

lockPosition.description: World axes along which the body cannot move ("z" for 2D games)

lockRotation.description: World axes around which the body cannot rotate ("xz" stays upright)

ccd.description: Continuous collision detection: fast objects never tunnel through walls

startAwake.description: Simulate from the start (false = sleep until touched)

velocity.description: Linear velocity m/s (initial; live while playing, writable)

angularVelocity.description: Angular velocity in degrees/s (initial; live while playing)

collider.description: Collision shape. Alone it makes static geometry (walls, floors); with a body it shapes the body. auto fits the mesh (box/sphere/capsule/cylinder for primitives, convex hull for dynamic models, triangle mesh for static models). mesh = exact triangles (static/kinematic only); convex = hull of the mesh; heightfield = terrain. isTrigger makes a sensor zone that fires `on trigger_enter` / `on trigger_exit` instead of blocking.

size.description: Box: full size (local units); heightfield: x/z extent, y = max height

height.description: Capsule/cylinder total height along local Y

offset.description: Shape center relative to the entity origin (local)

rotation.description: Shape rotation relative to the entity (Euler degrees)

isTrigger.description: Sensor: detects overlaps (trigger_enter/exit) but never blocks

friction.description: Material friction override (-1 = use the body's)

restitution.description: Material bounciness override (-1 = use the body's)

heightmap.description: Heightfield source, project-relative: 16-bit .r16/.raw (square) or .hdr; empty = sample the mesh

character.description: Capsule character controller: walks up slopes and stairs, slides along walls, rides moving platforms, pushes dynamic bodies and is detected by triggers. Drive it from Wander every tick: walk(self, dir), jump(self), grounded(self). Units are meters (not scaled by the transform).

offset.description: Capsule center relative to the entity origin in m (y = height/2 for models with the origin at the feet)

moveSpeed.description: Walking speed in m/s for walk(self, dir) with |dir| = 1

jumpSpeed.description: Upward speed of jump() in m/s

turnSpeed.description: Degrees/s to turn toward the walk direction (0 = off)

pushStrength.description: Max force in N used to push dynamic bodies

velocity.description: Current velocity m/s (live while playing; write for knockback)

joint.description: Connects this entity's body to another body (`target`) or to the world. fixed = welded; hinge = doors, wheels, levers (axis, limits in degrees, motor); ball = chains, ragdoll shoulders; slider = pistons, drawers (axis, limits in m); distance = rope/rod (limits = min/max length); spring = bouncy link (stiffness Hz, damping). Breaks above breakForce (fires `on event "joint_broken"` on this entity).

target.description: Other entity (name, #id or {"id"}); empty = attached to the world — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

anchor.description: Pivot point in this entity's local space

connectedAnchor.description: distance/spring: the other end in the target's local space (a world point when attached to the world)

axis.description: Hinge axis / slider direction in local space

limitMin.description: Lower limit: degrees (hinge), m (slider, distance); used when min < max

motorSpeed.description: Motor target speed: degrees/s (hinge) or m/s (slider)

motorForce.description: Motor max torque (N m) or force (N); 0 = no motor

damping.description: Spring damping ratio (0 = bouncy, 1 = critically damped)

breakForce.description: Breaks when the joint force exceeds this (N); 0 = unbreakable

collideConnected.description: Let the two connected bodies collide with each other

enabled.description: Active (set to false when the joint breaks)

physics_world.description: Scene-wide physics settings. One per scene (on any entity; the physics_settings tool manages it).

substeps.description: Collision steps per tick (1..8; more = stabler stacks, fast objects)

ignorePairs.description: Comma-separated layer pairs that never collide, e.g. "debris-player, projectile-projectile" (layers: default, static, player, enemy, projectile, trigger, debris)

enabled.description: Run the physics simulation while playing

nav_agent.description: Path-finding agent on the navigation mesh with local avoidance (crowds). Wander: navigate(self, target), stop_navigation(self), arrived(self); fires `on event "arrived"`. With a character component it walks the controller; otherwise it moves the transform.

radius.description: Radius used for avoidance in m

turnSpeed.description: Degrees/s to face the movement (0 = never rotate)

destination.description: World point to walk to (with navigating = true)

navigating.description: Heading to the destination (cleared on arrival)

autoRepath.description: Re-plan when blocked or when the destination changes

navmesh.description: Navigation-mesh bake settings and the saved bake (one per scene; nav_build creates it). Walkable surfaces come from static colliders and static meshes.

agentRadius.description: Agent radius in m (walls are eroded by it)

agentHeight.description: Agent height in m (lower ceilings block)

cellSize.description: Voxel size in m (radius/2..radius/3 is typical)

geometry.description: Input: both (colliders where present, else meshes), colliders only, or render meshes only

data.description: Baked navmesh file (project-relative), written by nav_build

autoBuild.description: Bake when play starts if the saved bake is missing or stale

animator.description: Skeletal animation for this entity's rigged meshes (and its children's): a state machine controller or one clip. Set parameters and triggers with animator_set or Wander set_param/trigger/play_animation.

library.description: Animation library (*.anim: skeleton + clips); empty = the one imported with the mesh

clip.description: Clip to play when there is no controller (empty = the first clip)

rootMotion.description: Move the entity with the animation's root (hips) movement instead of in place

preview.description: Editor preview: rest = bind pose, pose = frame at `time`, play = animate live

time.description: Editor preview time (seconds into the default state / clip)

lookAt.description: Entity the head and spine turn towards (look-at IK); empty = off — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

lookAtWeight.description: How strongly the head follows lookAt

attach.description: Keeps this entity on a bone of an animated character (weapon in a hand, hat on a head, lantern on a belt).

character.description: Entity with the animator; empty = nearest ancestor that has one — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

bone.description: Bone name, e.g. RightHand or mixamorig:Head (animation_list shows them)

offset.description: Position offset in the bone's space (meters)

rotation.description: Rotation offset in the bone's space (Euler degrees)

followScale.description: Inherit the bone's scale (off keeps this entity's scale)

sequencer.description: Plays a cinematic sequence (*.sequence.json): camera shots and cuts, keyed properties, events and animations. Build sequences with the sequence_* tools.

playOnStart.description: Start playing when the simulation starts

preview.description: Editor: show the sequence frozen at `time` in the viewport

ik.description: Two-bone IK effector: the character's hand or foot (and elbow or knee) reaches this entity's position.

character.description: Entity with the animator; empty = nearest ancestor that has one — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

bone.description: End bone that reaches here: LeftHand, RightFoot... (animation_list lists bones)

weight.description: Blend between the animation (0) and the target (1)

pole.description: Bend direction in the character's space (e.g. [0,0,-1] knees forward); [0,0,0] keeps the animated bend

matchRotation.description: Also orient the end bone like this entity

groom.description: Strand hair and fur grown on the entity's mesh (or `target`'s), or loaded from a .hair/.groom.json/.skygroom file. Rendered as real strands (Marschner shading, deep opacity self-shadowing, multiple scattering) and simulated on the GPU (gravity, wind, collisions). Easiest start: groom_create with a preset (hair_straight, hair_wavy, hair_curly, hair_ponytail, hair_short, fur_short, fur_long), then tweak fields.

source.description: Groom file (.hair = Cem Yuksel's format, .groom.json, .skygroom), project-relative; "" = grow procedurally on the mesh

target.description: Entity whose mesh grows the hair (empty = this entity) — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

importScale.description: Imported files: scale to meters (0.01 for centimeters)

importZUp.description: Imported files: the source is Z-up

strands.description: Rendered strands (head of hair 50k-150k; fur 100k+). Imported files: cap

segments.description: Segments per strand (smoothness of curls; 4 for fur, 16-31 for long hair)

widthRoot.description: Strand width at the root in millimeters (human hair 0.05-0.1)

widthTip.description: Strand width at the tip in millimeters

direction.description: Comb direction in the mesh's space (e.g. [0,-1,-0.4] = down and back)

directionBlend.description: 0 = grow along the surface normal, 1 = along `direction`

gravity.description: Droop: 0 = stands up (fur, crew cut) .. 1 = hangs down

curlRadius.description: Curl (helix) radius in meters (0.005-0.02 for curly hair)

curlFrequency.description: Curl turns per meter of strand

clumps.description: Clumps strands gather into (0 = none; hundreds for a head)

clumpStrength.description: How far strands pull into their clump

clumpShape.description: Clump profile: > 1 tips clump more than roots, < 1 clump early

ponytail.description: Comb every strand to ponytailPosition, then let them hang as one bundle

ponytailPosition.description: Where the ponytail is tied (mesh space, meters; just outside the scalp)

maskChannel.description: Vertex-color channel that controls density (scalp painting)

maskDirection.description: Grow only where the surface faces this way (mesh space; with maskAngle)

maskAngle.description: Degrees around maskDirection that grow hair (180 = everywhere)

melanin.description: Pigment (physically based absorption): 0 white, 0.1 platinum, 0.2 blond, 0.35 dark blond, 0.5 light brown, 0.7 brown, 0.85 dark brown, 0.95+ black

dye.description: Dye tint (white = natural) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

rootColor.description: Color multiplier at the roots (root-to-tip gradient, e.g. dark roots) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

tipColor.description: Color multiplier at the tips (sun-bleached or dyed tips) — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

roughness.description: Longitudinal roughness: highlight width (0.2 silky .. 0.6 dull)

radialRoughness.description: Azimuthal roughness: softness of light through the strand

scatter.description: Multiple scattering: light hair glows, dark hair stays rich

cuticleTilt.description: Cuticle tilt in degrees (separates the two highlights)

density.description: Coverage per strand (2 = a full head of hair at typical strand counts; lower for wispy, higher for thick)

simulate.description: Simulate on the GPU (gravity, wind, collisions)

stiffness.description: How strongly strands keep their groomed shape

collide.description: Collide with the mesh (sphere/capsule proxy) and `colliders`

colliders.description: Entities the hair collides with (shoulders, hands) — entity links: ["Hand", "#12", {"id": 7}] (a comma-separated string also works)

lod.description: auto = strands up close, cards far away; strands; cards (cheapest)

cardsBelow.description: auto LOD: draw cards when the groom is smaller than this (pixels)

castShadows.description: Cast sun shadows on the scene

seed.description: Random seed (a different head of the same style)

process.description: How this entity and its children run while the game is paused (pause_game) or slowed down (time_scale), the order their behaviors run in, and whether their motion is smoothed between 60 Hz ticks on fast displays. A pause menu canvas runs `always` (UI canvases do by default); enemies stay `pausable`.

mode.description: inherit (from the parent; root default pausable) | pausable (stops while the game is paused) | when_paused (runs only while paused: pause menu logic) | always (never stops: UI, music controllers) | disabled (never runs, still drawn)

priority.description: Behavior run order: lower runs first (ties keep scene order). Not inherited

clock.description: inherit | game (dt follows time_scale: slow motion) | real (ignores time_scale: menus, HUD)

interpolation.description: inherit | on (motion is smoothed between ticks on screen) | off (shown exactly at tick positions: snapping things, pixel-art)

reflection_probe.description: A captured cubemap of the scene around this point. Glossy floors, metal and glass inside its influence volume reflect the room or street around them (box-projected so reflections line up with walls) instead of the sky, and take their ambient light from it. Screen-space reflections still win where they find a hit; the probe fills what is off screen; the sky fills the rest. Put one per room or street section (probe_add sizes it to the room), set `interior` for closed rooms so no sky light leaks in, and check it with probe_info and viewport_capture {debug_view: "reflection_probes"}.

shape.description: Influence volume: box (rooms, corridors, streets) or sphere

size.description: Box: influence extent in meters, centered on the entity (times its scale). Match the room

radius.description: Sphere: influence radius in meters (times the entity scale)

blendDistance.description: Meters inside the volume over which the probe fades into neighbors or the sky (0 = hard edge)

boxProjection.description: Parallax-correct reflections against the volume so they line up with its walls (rooms, corridors); off for open areas and distant scenery

projectionSize.description: Box (m) that reflections are projected onto when it should differ from the influence volume: a street split into several probes projects each onto the whole street (its facades and far ends). [0, 0, 0] = the volume itself

projectionOffset.description: Center of projectionSize's box relative to the entity (m, local axes)

intensity.description: Brightness of the probe's reflections and ambient light

interior.description: Closed room: no sky light inside the volume. Reflections and ambient come only from the probe, and the capture lights its walls with ambientColor instead of the sky (the sky still shows through windows)

ambient.description: Diffuse ambient inside the volume: probe (from the capture, default), sky (the probe only adds reflections), color (ambientColor x ambientEnergy)

ambientColor.description: Interior captures: the ambient light that replaces the sky's; ambient "color": the ambient inside — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

update.description: When to capture: once (cached; re-captured when the probe changes or on probe_bake), on_change (whenever something in range moves or changes), realtime (every `interval` frames)

interval.description: realtime: frames between captures (1 = every frame, within the face budget)

resolution.description: Cubemap face size in px: 64, 128, 256 (default) or 512; rounded to a power of two

cullMask.description: Render layers the capture draws (bit i = layer i+1; 1048575 = all). Leave the player out of realtime probes

priority.description: Where volumes overlap the higher priority wins (equal: the smaller volume)

captureOffset.description: Capture point relative to the entity in meters (local axes); keep it inside the room, away from walls

maxDistance.description: Capture far plane in meters (0 = automatic from the volume)

vehicle.description: Drivable wheeled vehicle (Jolt vehicle constraint): suspension, tire friction curves, engine torque curve, auto/manual gearbox, FWD/RWD/AWD limited-slip differentials, anti-roll bars, downforce and drag. Needs a dynamic `body` on the same entity (the chassis). Child entities named wheel* are the wheels (fitted automatically when `wheels` is empty) and spin/steer/bounce while playing. Drive it with the inputs (throttle, brake, steer, handbrake): control=player reads the drive input actions, or set them from Wander (vehicle_drive(self, ...)). Build one with vehicle_create, tune by numbers with vehicle_tune + vehicle_test_drive, watch it with vehicle_info.

preset.description: Preset it was built from (informational): sports, hatchback, truck, kart, custom

mass.description: Chassis mass in kg (kart 160, hatchback 1150, sports 1350, truck 2600)

centerOfMass.description: Center-of-mass offset in m (local); lower y = less body roll, harder to flip

maxTilt.description: Max pitch/roll in degrees before the chassis is held upright (180 = can flip)

entity.description: child entity that shows this wheel (spins, steers, follows the suspension)

position.description: wheel center at rest, chassis-local m

wheels.description: Per-wheel setup in chassis space; empty = fitted at play from children named wheel*. Any field overrides the vehicle default for that wheel

wheelRadius.description: Wheel radius in m (0 = measured from the wheel meshes)

suspensionMinLength.description: Suspension length fully compressed (m below the mount)

suspensionMaxLength.description: Suspension length fully extended (m below the mount)

suspensionFrequency.description: Spring frequency in Hz (1 soft, 1.6 road, 2.5+ race)

brakeTorque.description: Brake torque per wheel in N m at full brake

handbrakeTorque.description: Handbrake torque per rear wheel in N m

longitudinalGrip.description: Peak tire friction accelerating/braking (1 economy tires, 1.25 sports, 1.6 slicks)

lateralGrip.description: Peak tire friction cornering: about the skidpad g (0.9 hatchback, 1.1 sports; lower = slides sooner)

longitudinalCurve.description: Tire friction vs slip ratio [[slip, 0..1], ...] (scaled by longitudinalGrip); empty = default

lateralCurve.description: Tire friction vs slip angle [[degrees, 0..1], ...] (scaled by lateralGrip); empty = default

frontTorqueSplit.description: AWD: share of the torque sent to the front axle

limitedSlip.description: Limited-slip ratio of the differentials (1.4 tight, >= 10 open)

maxTorque.description: Peak engine torque in N m

engineInertia.description: Engine inertia in kg m^2 (lower revs faster)

torqueCurve.description: Torque vs rpm [[rpm fraction, torque fraction], ...]; empty = default

transmission.description: Gearbox: auto shifts by rpm; manual uses vehicle_shift / shift actions

gearRatios.description: Forward gear ratios, first gear first; empty = [2.66, 1.78, 1.3, 1.0, 0.74]

shiftUpRpm.description: Auto gearbox shifts up above this rpm

shiftDownRpm.description: Auto gearbox shifts down below this rpm

antiRollFront.description: Front anti-roll bar (0 none, 300 soft, 700 sporty, 2000 very stiff; above ~4000 the body can shake)

antiRollRear.description: Rear anti-roll bar (stiffer than the front = more oversteer)

downforce.description: Aero downforce in N per (m/s)^2 (0.4 road car, 2+ race car)

drag.description: Aero drag in N per (m/s)^2 (limits top speed; ~0.5 * rho * Cd * area)

control.description: Who sets the inputs: player = drive input actions, script = Wander/tools, none

steerSpeed.description: Steering response: full lock per second (0 = instant)

tractionControl.description: Traction control: limits wheelspin under throttle

abs.description: Anti-lock brakes: keeps the wheels rolling (and steering) under hard braking

driftAssist.description: Arcade drift help 0..1: easy slides that hold their angle

autoReverse.description: Holding brake at a standstill reverses

engineAudio.description: Drive the entity's audio component: pitch from rpm, volume from load

gear.description: Current gear (-1 reverse, 0 neutral); manual gearbox: write to shift

speed.description: Telemetry: km/h along the heading (negative reversing)

skid.description: Telemetry: strongest tire slide 0..1 (tire smoke, skid marks, squeal)

chase_camera.description: Spring-arm chase camera: follows `target` from behind with look-ahead into corners, collision pull-in and a field of view that widens with speed. Put it on an entity with a camera (vehicle_create chase_camera=true sets it up). Moves every tick while playing.

target.description: Entity to follow (the vehicle) — entity link: name ("Door"), "#id", {"id": 12} or null; read back as {"id", "name"} (follows renames; entity_refs lists links)

distance.description: Distance behind the target in m

height.description: Height above the target in m

targetHeight.description: Aim point above the target origin in m

lookAhead.description: Seconds of velocity to aim ahead

turnStiffness.description: How fast the arm swings behind the target in 1/s

fovMin.description: Field of view at a standstill (degrees)

fovSpeed.description: Speed in m/s where the field of view reaches fovMax

collide.description: Pull the camera in when a wall blocks the view

environment.description: Scene-wide sky, sun, ambient light, fog and exposure.

skyTop.description: Sky color at the zenith — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

skyHorizon.description: Sky color at the horizon — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

ground.description: Ambient bounce color from below — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

sunElevation.description: Sun height above horizon in degrees

sunColor.description: Sun light color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

fogColor.description: Distance fog color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1

autoExposure.description: Adapt exposure to scene brightness (eye adaptation)

bloomThreshold.description: Brightness where glow starts (lower = more glow)

chromaticAberration.description: Lens color fringing toward the frame edges

lut.description: Optional .cube 3D LUT file (project-relative); when set it replaces the look (lookStrength blends it)

skyMode.description: gradient = two artist colors; atmosphere = physically inspired sky from the sun; hdri = a photographed .hdr panorama lights and backs the scene (set `hdri`)

hdriRotation.description: Panorama rotation in degrees (line its sun up with sunAzimuth)

cloudMode.description: Clouds: volumetric (ray-marched, lit, shadows) or flat (cheap)

cloudHeight.description: Cloud layer base height in meters

cloudScale.description: Cloud feature size (0.5 small puffs .. 3 huge banks)

cloudSpeed.description: Cloud drift speed in m/s (along windDirection)

fogHeight.description: Fog pools near the ground as this grows (0 = uniform)

ao.description: Ambient occlusion (contact shadows in corners and creases)

gi.description: Screen-space global illumination: bounce and emissive light (0 = sky light only)

giDistance.description: Global illumination ray length in meters

ssr.description: Screen-space reflections on glossy surfaces (wet streets, floors, metal)

taa.description: Temporal anti-aliasing (smooth edges, stable shimmer-free detail)

renderScale.description: Real-time internal resolution: 0.5-0.77 renders fewer pixels and MetalFX temporal upscaling reconstructs full resolution (faster); 1 = native. Stills and captures with samples > 1 render native.

shadowDistance.description: Sun shadow range in meters (0 = automatic)

godRays.description: Volumetric light: sun shafts through trees and windows, cones under lamps (0 = off, 1 = natural)

haze.description: Air density for volumetric light, extinction per meter: 0.0003 clear landscape, 0.002 hazy valley, 0.01-0.03 misty alley or interior

windSpeed.description: Wind (m/s) that carries smoke, rain, snow and particles

localShadowAtlas.description: Point/spot shadow atlas size in px: 2048 (16 MB), 4096 (64 MB, default), 8192 (256 MB)

localShadowLights.description: Most point/spot lights with shadows per frame (the most important on screen); the rest light without shadows. 0 = no local shadows

localShadowUpdates.description: Point/spot shadow views re-rendered per frame when lights or casters move (cube light = 6, spot = 1); later updates wait a frame. Stills render all

probeBudget.description: Reflection probes with a slot in the probe atlas (the most important in view first; the rest fall back to the sky). Max 32; 0 = probes off

probeUpdates.description: Reflection probe cube faces captured per frame (a whole probe = 6); later captures wait a frame. Stills capture everything
